rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese term for gravitational force.

example.english: Astronauts feel that gravitation is much weaker when walking on the moon.
example.traditional: 太空人喺月球上面行路，感覺到重力細好多。
example.jyutping: taai3 hung1 jan4 hai2 jyut6 kau4 soeng6 min6 haang4 lou6 gam2 gok3 dou3 cung5 lik6 sai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this technical term when referring specifically to universal gravitation between all matter.

example.english: The textbook explains that gravitation makes the Earth orbit the Sun.
example.traditional: 教科書指出，萬有引力令地球繞住太陽運行。
example.jyutping: gaau3 fo1 syu1 zi2 ceot1 maan6 jau5 jan5 lik6 ling6 dei6 kau4 jiu2 zyu6 taai3 joeng4 wan6 hang4
